description: Ontology worklist membership and base order. Executed server-side by the Signal read route (task 038, D-15), never by DataGrid in the browser. Carries no actions and no per-user filter; the route removes rows the caller cannot read, applies the Do-lane reader scope and the D-42 rank. The policy short name, work type and severity are read by the route as the BFF (D-185), so no query links sprk_policy.

closedToday.note: Resolved in the last widenHours hours (a local day is never older). The route keeps an item only if it was resolved today in its own time zone (D-25).
